scope: Method critique only; all numerical examples artificial.
prior_exposure: Existing label list and old research descriptions were known.
Root coordination messages described planned four-feature implementation and synthetic checks; neither root code nor its check file was read.
not_read_or_performed: New nine-location images or qualification reports
Modification of root draft, plan, website or old reports
recommendation: Use four purely depicted-geometry features; preserve joint object/candidate constraints and signed common-presence/common-absence decomposition.

final_feature_proposal.name: local depicted widening
final_feature_proposal.definition: Traceable wide outline relative to an attached connector, width ratio >=3; no flat/solid judgement or not-F1 exclusion. Do not use terminal taper, corner or globally thinnest pixel as neck.
final_feature_proposal.necessary_record: Width and connector cross-sections, local direction, boundary alternatives, drawing style, threshold uncertainty.
final_feature_proposal.limitation: Ink-line width is a depiction feature, not biological diameter. Definability is not guaranteed.

final_feature_proposal.name: traceable three-arm connection
final_feature_proposal.definition: At least three separately traceable connector arms reach one visible joining region; undirected and independent of plant orientation.
final_feature_proposal.necessary_record: Joining-region and arm witnesses; distinguish connector arms from two edges of one outline.
final_feature_proposal.limitation: Crossing, overlap or concealed contact remains unknown when connectivity cannot be established.

final_feature_proposal.name: at least three slender ends
final_feature_proposal.definition: At least three distinct ends with traceable length from last attachment/fork to end, divided by maximum transverse width of the same extension, >=3.
final_feature_proposal.necessary_record: End witnesses, lengths/widths, count lower/upper bounds; single-ink-line drawing explicitly recorded.
final_feature_proposal.limitation: Unknown ownership or branching cannot manufacture distinct ends; paper geometry does not identify roots/leaves.

final_feature_proposal.name: repeated internal transverse lines
final_feature_proposal.definition: At least two distinct lines inside one traceable shaft each connect its two sides and occur sequentially along it.
final_feature_proposal.necessary_record: Shaft extent, two boundary-spanning line witnesses, excluded text/other-object/crack alternatives.
final_feature_proposal.limitation: No claim of biological compartments. Geometrically qualifying hatching cannot be removed solely by inferred function.

coding_rules.positive: One unambiguous belonging instance suffices within a fixed candidate; other missing portions need not invalidate it.
coding_rules.negative: All possible qualifying instances ruled out across relevant complete candidate scope.
coding_rules.unknown: Ambiguous visibility, assignment, extent or threshold; never filled with zero.
coding_rules.threshold_intervals: For width threshold: w_lower >= 3*n_upper certifies passing; w_upper < 3*n_lower certifies failing for that instance; overlap retains uncertainty.

estimand.Tf: (1/3) sum_s [mean_{same pairs in s} I(x_i=x_j) - mean_{different pairs in s} I(x_i=x_j)]
estimand.T11: Same weights, replacing I(equal) by I(both 1).
estimand.T00: Same weights, replacing I(equal) by I(both 0).
limits: Equal leaf-pair-stratum average is not pooled all-cross-leaf-pair average.
Feature correlation prevents interpreting four features as four independent lines of evidence.
Positive agreement contrast may be driven entirely by common absence.
No randomization p-value, causal claim or species/meaning inference.

bounds_review.candidate_rule: Choose one admissible global candidate assignment before optimizing features; preserve it across every pair and feature.
bounds_review.canonical_rule: Same physical group and same feature share one variable. Shared fragments alone do not force all whole-group features equal.
bounds_review.lower: min_c [(1/K) sum_f min_{x in A_f(c)} Tf(x)]
bounds_review.upper: max_c [(1/K) sum_f max_{x in A_f(c)} Tf(x)]
bounds_review.proof: For fixed c and a finite Cartesian domain, every individual feature minimizer/maximizer can be combined into a jointly feasible assignment. Then global candidate extrema are attained by one c.
bounds_review.nonseparable_case: Joint constraints require joint optimization; removing them gives a declared conservative outer bound, not a feasible sharp bound.
bounds_review.conflict: A canonical variable forced to both 0 and 1 gives an empty domain/input contradiction; do not average, silently drop or relabel it unknown.
bounds_review.enumeration_limit: At most 2^9 assignments per feature per fixed candidate before canonical equalities; this does not bound the number of candidate combinations.
implementation_checks: Retain candidate and complete canonical assignment attaining each bound.
Reconstruct each stratum, feature, T11/T00 and total from one witness.
Verify candidate admissibility, known values and all joint constraints.
Handle empty domains/zero denominators as explicit errors or defined unavailable states, never zero scores.
Verify full domain coverage independently; a caller separability flag is a declaration rather than a proof.
Keep exact rational arithmetic where possible.

independent_artificial_examples.scope: One artificial stratum; may be duplicated into three identical hypothetical strata. Not real layer counts.

independent_artificial_examples.meaning: Imputing missing endpoints as absent selects a favorable completion
One unknown must be shared across pairs
Cross-feature dependence invalidates sharp separate extrema

toy_verification: Examples A1–A4 were evaluated independently with Python standard-library Fraction and complete stated binary enumerations, without importing root code. These check arithmetic only, not manuscript measurement capability.
concrete_misinterpretations: Identical oval contours do not discriminate a thin sheet from a solid mass.
Two outline sides can be mistaken for branches.
Three nearby writing strokes can be mistaken for terminal structures.
Hatching can be mistaken for real biological segmentation.
Unavailable or undefined object can be mistaken for feature absence.
scope_boundary: Undefined unit blocks the nine-location estimand under the existing plan. Defined units with unknown features may still yield honest deterministic bounds; do not add an all-clear-case exclusion gate.
